data.contract: latency/roles/overlap use planned-arrival cohort; CPU and admission counters use whole run; reroutes are task placements, not kernel migrations; overlap is callback wall time, not CPU or causal delay; two seeds are mechanism screening, not stable p99 validation

work_contract.validation: mechanism experiment, not production replay or equal measured CPU work

target_admission.contract: Whole-run selections/chunks, including submission attempts; not completed callbacks or cohort counts. One primary reason per selection; candidate filters may count multiple attempts. NoEligibleTarget is also included in stats.no_eligible_target. Disabled policy maintains no admission counts. Selected target pressure in tasks.csv is valid only when admission_evaluated=1; all selection fields repeat for members of a chunk. Approximate (O+R+B)/C: reservation handoff can double-count and concurrent choices can exceed the observed limit. Not a hard capacity or CPU measurement.
